title: RefinementList, hide the facet block when only 1 result
body:
Following this magento issue https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-magento/issues/318
I did not find a way to do this.

And I think it could make sense to add an option.

comments.body:
For now you could always do it very hacky way by showing/hiding facet blocks by looking at the number of facet values you get in a render() call of a specific widget (or just by subscribing to the helper.on('results') event.

As for providing an option to do it directly in instantsearch.js => everything is doable but needs an API entry that is making sense and easy to name. Go for it :)

Well this widget is both for filtering and displaying a summary of the answers. So my call is to say that it depends on the implementor's desire and the UX he/she is looking for and therefore not a bug.
